answer_1.quote: We are the first to investigate the generation of explicitly hurtful stereotypes in language models for English and five gender-inflected languages (Italian, French, Portuguese, Romanian, and Span-ish).
datasets: a novel benchmark data set of manually-created sentence templates

answer_2.quote: We use HurtLex , a multilingual lexicon of hurtful language, to evaluate the completions.

answer_4.quote: Our templates have been checked by native speakers of each of the five languages to ensure we create syntactically correct and meaningful sentences. Moreover, we asked the native speakers to make the templates as natural as possible in the respective language.
answer_4.guideline: ensure we create syntactically correct and meaningful sentences... make the templates as natural as possible
